scope: Existing marketing embed on this development Mac; exact macOS arm64 local-triage package. No inference during interaction.

rationale.embedUpdate: Keep synchronous render work within one 60 Hz frame for the bounded six-node component.
rationale.embedStartup: Usable static fallback is immediate; interactive readiness has a two-second local cold-load ceiling.
rationale.memory: Bound retained growth after repeated revisions rather than treating temporary allocations as a leak.
rationale.localHost: File-backed exact-head commands are explicit actions; a two-second ceiling keeps them separate from local keystrokes.
rationale.native: Observe actual accessibility-visible readiness and completed task updates, including measurement overhead. Main-process RSS excludes separately managed WebKit processes.
